study_name: Optical vs SAR vs Joint Corroboration Ablation
hypotheses: Optical provides high spectral context but suffers from cloud/shadow false positives. SAR provides all-weather structural backscatter but suffers from smooth-surface specular ambiguities. Joint corroboration eliminates single-modality false alarms.

results.primary_limitation: Cloud shadows and dark asphalt confused with water.
Smooth flat runways and dry lakebeds exhibit specular reflection (< -20 dB) similar to water.

results.improvement_notes: Cross-modal agreement check rejects optical shadow and SAR runway false positives, increasing overall F1 by +10.6%.
